column1: # Seeds for git-safety.sh. <expect><TAB><cwd><TAB><command>. expect T = must deny, N = must not.
# cwd MAIN, WT, RMAIN or RWT. {MAIN}/{WT}: fake paths outside temp folders, for git verbs.
# {RMAIN}/{RWT}: a real repo + linked worktree, for write-shaped commands. Both worktrees hold a contract.
# \n in a command is a newline. Every T row must deny at head, unvaried (the run's positive control).
